questions.stem: 無論紙本文件保存得多麼小心，終究會損壞，這就是我們需要數位典藏（digital archives）的原因。
questions.answer: No matter how carefully paper documents are stored, they will eventually be damaged, which is the reason why we need digital archives.
accepted_answers: No matter how carefully paper documents are kept, they will be damaged sooner or later, which is exactly why we need digital archives.
No matter how carefully we store paper documents, they will eventually get damaged, which is why we need digital archives.

patterns: 讓步：無論多麼（no matter how + 副詞）

questions.stem: 它們保存了許多可能永遠遺失的老照片，這讓年輕一代能看見祖先當年的生活。
questions.answer: They have preserved many old photos that could have been lost forever, which allows the younger generation to see how their ancestors lived.
accepted_answers: They have saved many old photos that might otherwise be lost forever, which lets young people see what their ancestors' lives were like.
They keep many old photos that would otherwise be lost forever, which allows young people to see what life was like for their ancestors.

patterns: 關係代名詞 that 引導的形容詞子句
非限定關係子句（, which allows …）

1.explanation_zh: 「無論…多麼小心」用 No matter how + 副詞 carefully + 主詞 + 動詞（直述句語序）；文件是「被」保存，用被動 are stored，也可以改成主動 we store paper documents。「終究會損壞」文件是承受者，用被動 will eventually be damaged（或 get damaged）。「這就是…的原因」用 the reason why …（關係副詞 why 修飾 reason），接在句尾時寫成 , which is the reason why …（which 指前面整句），也可以簡化成 which is why …。
evidence: 無論紙本文件保存得多麼小心
這就是我們需要數位典藏（digital archives）的原因
1.strategy_zh: 「無論多麼＋形容詞／副詞」→ No matter how + adj./adv. + S + V；「這就是…的原因」→ which is (the reason) why + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：無論紙本文件保存得多麼小心／終究會損壞／這就是…的原因／我們需要數位典藏
標的詞彙：carefully（小心地）、paper（紙本）、document（文件）、store（保存）、eventually（終究）、damage（損壞）、need（需要）
句型框架：No matter how + adv. + S + be p.p., S + will eventually be p.p., which is the reason why + S + V

2.explanation_zh: 主詞「它們」指上一句的數位典藏，「保存了」用現在完成式 have preserved。「可能永遠遺失的老照片」修飾語很長，英文用關係代名詞 that 往後修飾；照片是被遺失，用被動 could have been lost（加 otherwise＝「要不是被保存」語意更清楚）。「這讓…」指前面整件事，用 , which allows … to V。「祖先當年的生活」用名詞子句 how their ancestors lived 最自然。
evidence: 可能永遠遺失的老照片
這讓年輕一代能看見祖先當年的生活
2.strategy_zh: 名詞前面有很長的「…的」→ 關係子句後位修飾；「…，這讓＋人＋V」→ , which allows + 人 + to V。
hints: 切成四段：它們保存了／許多可能永遠遺失的老照片／這讓年輕一代／能看見祖先當年的生活
標的詞彙：preserve（保存）、photo（照片）、lose（遺失）、forever（永遠）、generation（一代）、see（看見）、ancestor（祖先）、live（生活）
句型框架：S + have p.p. + N + that could have been p.p. …, which allows + O + to see how + S + V

patterns.label_zh: 讓步：無論多麼…（no matter how + 副詞）
patterns.frame: No matter how + adv. + S + V, S + V …
patterns.zh_trigger: 無論紙本文件保存得多麼小心

patterns.frame: …, which is the reason why + S + V

parts.zh: 無論紙本文件保存得多麼小心
accepted: No matter how carefully paper documents are stored
No matter how carefully paper documents are kept
No matter how carefully we store paper documents
No matter how carefully we keep paper documents
However carefully paper documents are stored

common_errors.wrong: No matter how careful paper documents are stored
common_errors.right: No matter how carefully paper documents are stored
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「保存得多麼小心」修飾動詞 store，要用副詞 carefully。

common_errors.wrong: No matter how carefully are paper documents stored
common_errors.right: No matter how carefully paper documents are stored
common_errors.explanation_zh: no matter how 後面用直述句語序（主詞＋動詞），不倒裝。

accepted: they will eventually be damaged
they will be damaged sooner or later
they will eventually get damaged
they will be damaged in the end

common_errors.explanation_zh: 文件是「被」損壞，要用被動 be damaged（或 get damaged）；will damage 是「會去損壞別的東西」。
paper documents 是複數，代名詞用 they。

accepted: which is the reason why
which is exactly why
which is why
and that is why
and this is the reason why

common_errors.wrong: damaged, this is the reason why
common_errors.right: damaged, which is the reason why
common_errors.explanation_zh: 前面已經是完整句子，用逗號接 this is … 會變成逗號連接句；改用 , which is the reason why …，或另起一句 This is why …。

common_errors.wrong: the reason why we need digital archives is because
common_errors.right: the reason why we need digital archives
common_errors.explanation_zh: the reason why 和 because 意思重複，只能二選一。

accepted: we need digital archives
we need a digital archive
digital archives are needed

common_errors.explanation_zh: archive 是可數名詞，泛指時用複數 archives 或加 a。
need 是一般動詞，前面不加 be 動詞。

traps.literal_error: No matter how careful paper documents are stored
traps.explanation_zh: 「保存得多麼小心」的「小心」修飾動詞「保存」，英文用副詞 how carefully；careful 是形容詞。

traps.zh: 這就是我們需要數位典藏（digital archives）的原因
traps.literal_error: The reason why we need digital archives is because they will be damaged.
traps.explanation_zh: 「這就是…的原因」英文用 which is (the reason) why …；不要寫成 the reason … is because …，reason 和 because 意思重複。

bonus.text: However carefully paper documents are stored, time will eventually take its toll on them, which is precisely why digital archives matter.
bonus.explanation_zh: However carefully … 等於 No matter how carefully …；take its toll on（對…造成損害）、matter（很重要）都是道地寫法。這是加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「這就是我們需要數位典藏的原因」中文另起一句，英文可以用 , which is the reason why … 接在前一句後面，which 指前面整件事。

references: They have preserved many old photos that could have been lost forever, which allows the younger generation to see how their ancestors lived.
They have saved many old photos that might otherwise be lost forever, which lets young people see what their ancestors' lives were like.
They keep many old photos that would otherwise be lost forever, which allows young people to see what life was like for their ancestors.

patterns.label_zh: 關係代名詞 that 引導的限定子句（可能永遠遺失的老照片）
patterns.zh_trigger: 可能永遠遺失的老照片

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句：which 指前面整句（這讓…）
patterns.frame: S + V …, which allows + O + to V …

accepted: They have preserved
They have saved
They keep
They preserve

common_errors.explanation_zh: 現在完成式是 have + 過去分詞 preserved。

common_errors.wrong: They are preserved many old photos
common_errors.right: They have preserved many old photos
common_errors.explanation_zh: 主詞 They（數位典藏）主動保存照片，不用被動 are preserved。

parts.zh: 許多可能永遠遺失的老照片
accepted: many old photos that could have been lost forever
many old photos that might otherwise be lost forever
many old photos that would otherwise be lost forever
many old photos that might be lost forever

common_errors.wrong: many old photos that could lose forever
common_errors.right: many old photos that could be lost forever
common_errors.explanation_zh: 照片是「被」遺失，要用被動 be lost；主動 lose 是「弄丟（別的東西）」。

common_errors.wrong: many may be lost forever old photos
common_errors.right: many old photos that might be lost forever
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文修飾語「可能永遠遺失的」在名詞前，英文要用關係子句放在 photos 後面。

accepted: which allows the younger generation to
which lets young people
which allows young people to
which enables the younger generation to

common_errors.wrong: which allows the younger generation see
common_errors.right: which allows the younger generation to see
common_errors.explanation_zh: allow + 受詞 + to V；let 才接原形動詞。

common_errors.wrong: forever, that allows the younger generation to
common_errors.right: forever, which allows the younger generation to
common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後面補充說明整件事，用 which，不用 that。

parts.zh: 能看見祖先當年的生活
accepted: see how their ancestors lived
see what their ancestors' lives were like
see what life was like for their ancestors
see their ancestors' lives back then

common_errors.wrong: see their ancestors that year life
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「祖先當年的生活」不要逐字疊成 that year life；用 how their ancestors lived 或 what life was like for their ancestors。

common_errors.wrong: see what was life like for their ancestors
common_errors.right: see what life was like for their ancestors
common_errors.explanation_zh: 間接問句用直述句語序：what + life + was like。

traps.zh: 可能永遠遺失的老照片
traps.literal_error: many may lose forever old photos
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「可能永遠遺失的」放在「老照片」前面，英文要先寫 photos，再用 that 子句往後修飾；照片是被遺失，要用被動 be lost。

traps.literal_error: see their ancestors' that year life
traps.explanation_zh: 「當年的生活」是抽象概念，不要逐字翻成 that year life；改成名詞子句 how their ancestors lived 或 what life was like for their ancestors。

bonus.text: Thanks to them, countless old photos that might otherwise have been lost are kept safe, giving younger generations a window into their ancestors' lives.
bonus.explanation_zh: Thanks to them（多虧它們）承接上一句；句尾分詞 giving … a window into …（讓…一窺…）表結果，是比喻性的進階寫法。這是加分寫法。

2.restructuring_zh: 「可能永遠遺失的老照片」中文修飾語在前，英文改成 photos that could have been lost forever；「看見祖先當年的生活」改寫成名詞子句 how their ancestors lived。

1.translation: No matter how carefully paper documents are preserved, they will eventually be damaged, which is why we need digital archives.
1.explanation_zh: 「無論…多麼小心」用 no matter how carefully＋被動 are preserved；「終究會損壞」用 will eventually be damaged（也可 deteriorate）；「這就是…的原因」指前面整件事，用 which is why…，維持一句。

2.translation: They have preserved many old photos that might otherwise have been lost forever, which allows the younger generation to see how their ancestors lived back then.
2.explanation_zh: 「保存了」用現在完成式；「可能永遠遺失的老照片」用關係子句，因為實際上被保存下來，用 might otherwise have been lost 表示「要不是有它們就會遺失」（也可寫 could be lost forever）；「這讓…能看見」用 which allows…to see；「祖先當年的生活」用 how their ancestors lived back then。信心中等是因為「可能永遠遺失」的時態有兩種合理寫法。

issues_zh: 盲譯把「保存」譯成 preserved（No matter how carefully paper documents are preserved），是「保存（文件）」最貼切的字，但第 1 部分 accepted 只收 stored／kept，標的詞彙 store 的 alternatives 只有 keep；同一組第 2 句的「保存」反而以 preserve 為標的詞彙，前後不一致。建議 store 補 preserve、save，第 1 部分 accepted 補 are preserved。
標的句型標成 REL（關係副詞 why），但三個參考譯文實際上都是 , which is (the reason／exactly) why …，關鍵結構是指前面整句的 which（非限定關係子句）；第 3 部分 accepted 又收 and that is why（沒有關係詞），句型代碼與可接受寫法對不太上，建議改標 NRREL 或在說明寫清楚。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義
第 1 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：盲譯把「保存」譯成 preserved（No matter how carefully paper documents are preserved），是「保存（文件）」最貼切的字，但第 1 部分 accepted 只收 stored／kep

1.translation: No matter how carefully paper documents are preserved, they will eventually be damaged, which is why we need digital archives.
1.explanation_zh: 「無論……多麼小心」用 no matter how carefully 加被動 are preserved；「終究會損壞」用 will eventually be damaged；「這就是……的原因」用 which is why 接整句。

2.translation: They preserve many old photos that might otherwise be lost forever, which allows the younger generation to see how their ancestors lived back then.
2.explanation_zh: 「可能永遠遺失的老照片」用關係子句 that might otherwise be lost forever，otherwise 帶出「若沒有數位典藏」的假設；「這讓……能看見」用 which allows ... to see；「當年的生活」用間接問句 how their ancestors lived back then。

issues_zh: 「保存」我譯成 preserved，是這個語境最自然的搭配，但第 1 部分 accepted 只有 stored／kept；同組第 2 句反而把 preserve 列為標的詞，兩句對「保存」的處理不一致，建議第 1 句 accepted 補 preserved。
第 3 部分 accepted 的 and that is why、and this is the reason why 不是 which 引導的關係子句，和標的句型 REL（…, which is the reason why …）的寫法不同；學生這樣寫正確，但沒有用到標的句型。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義
